tagline.en: Laredo to Lake Superior, the middle of the country
tagline.zh: 自拉雷多到苏必利尔湖，纵贯国土中部

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: US 83 at the Mexican border in Laredo, Texas
start.zh: 得克萨斯州拉雷多，墨西哥边境，接 US 83

end.zh: 明尼苏达州德卢斯，与 MN 61 相接

en: I-35 runs up the middle of the country from the Mexican border to Lake Superior, through San Antonio, Austin, Dallas–Fort Worth, Oklahoma City, Wichita, Kansas City, Des Moines, the Twin Cities and Duluth. It is the main north–south freight corridor for the central United States and the road that carries the bulk of overland trade with Mexico, which enters at Laredo.

It is the only Interstate that splits into lettered halves twice. Approaching Dallas and Fort Worth from the south it divides into I-35E and I-35W and rejoins at Denton; approaching Minneapolis and Saint Paul it divides again and rejoins north of the Twin Cities. Those branches are logged as separate routes.

The landscape shifts in a fairly orderly way — south Texas brush, the Hill Country escarpment at Austin, blackland prairie, the Flint Hills, corn, and finally the northern forest as the road drops down the hill into Duluth and stops at the lakeshore. The southern third and the Twin Cities section are urban freeway; much of Oklahoma, Kansas and Iowa is not.
zh: I-35 自墨西哥边境沿国土中部北上直抵苏必利尔湖，途经圣安东尼奥、奥斯汀、达拉斯—沃思堡、俄克拉何马城、威奇托、堪萨斯城、得梅因、双子城与德卢斯。它是美国中部主要的南北货运走廊，也是承载对墨西哥陆路贸易主体的道路——那些货物从拉雷多入境。
它是唯一两度分裂为带字母分支的州际公路。自南侧接近达拉斯与沃思堡时，它分为 I-35E 与 I-35W，在丹顿重新合并；接近明尼阿波利斯与圣保罗时又再分一次，在双子城以北合并。这些分支在路线志中作为独立路线登记。
沿途景观的更替相当有秩序——南得州的灌丛、奥斯汀处的山丘地断崖、黑土草原、弗林特山、玉米地，最后是北方森林：道路顺坡而下进入德卢斯，止于湖岸。南段三分之一与双子城段是城市高速，而俄克拉何马、堪萨斯与艾奥瓦的大部分路段并非如此。

en: The route was authorised with the original system and mostly built in the 1960s, largely replacing older US highways — in Minnesota, portions of US 61 and US 65. It reached Duluth in 1971, and there it stopped for sixteen years at an interchange with Mesaba Avenue.

The hold-up was the last two miles. In 1958 the Minnesota Highway Department had proposed carrying the freeway on pillars along the Lake Superior shoreline through downtown Duluth, removing buildings and cutting the city off from its waterfront. By 1970 organised opposition — one group called Citizens for Integrating Highways and the Environment, another simply Stop the Freeway — had made that politically impossible. Clearing the route also required relocating a sprawling railroad yard to Superior, Wisconsin.

The compromise was to keep the road but bury it: cut-and-cover tunnels with parkland on the lid. Digging began in 1983, the extension opened to Lake Avenue in 1987 and to a temporary end in 1989, and the final link through the Leif Erickson Tunnel opened on 28 October 1992 — completing not just I-35 but one of the last gaps in the original Interstate system. The congressman who cut the ribbon called it a citizens' freeway.
zh: 这条路线随最初的系统一并获批，主体建于 1960 年代，多为取代更早的联邦公路——在明尼苏达取代的是 US 61 与 US 65 的部分路段。它于 1971 年抵达德卢斯，并在那里的梅萨巴大道立交停滞了十六年。
卡住的是最后两英里。1958 年，明尼苏达公路局曾提议让高速公路以立柱高架的方式沿苏必利尔湖岸穿过德卢斯市中心，这需要拆除建筑，并把城市与其滨水区切断。到 1970 年，有组织的反对——一个团体叫「公民促进公路与环境融合会」，另一个干脆叫「阻止高速公路」——已使该方案在政治上不可行。清理线位还需要把一处占地广阔的铁路调车场迁往威斯康星州苏必利尔市。
折中方案是保留道路但把它埋起来：明挖回填隧道，顶上覆以公园。1983 年开挖，延伸段 1987 年通至湖滨大道，1989 年通至一处临时终点，最后穿越莱夫·埃里克森隧道的一段于 1992 年 10 月 28 日通车——不仅使 I-35 全线贯通，也填上了最初的州际公路系统中最后的缺口之一。为其剪彩的国会议员称它是一条「公民的高速公路」。

en: The Duluth ending cost more per mile than almost anything else on the route. The 1958 plan for an elevated road was expected to take ten years and $45 million; moving the railroad switching yards alone was later reckoned at the same figure and the same timescale. The finished extension from Mesaba Avenue to 26th Avenue East came to $220 million, and it has since collected three federal Excellence in Design awards.

The current expense is at the other end of the road, in Austin, where the freeway opened in 1962 and its stacked upper decks in 1975. TxDOT's Capital Express programme covers about 28 miles in three projects with listed construction costs of roughly $5.65 billion. The central eight miles alone account for about $4.5 billion: the upper decks come down, the road is widened into neighbouring property, and two carpool lanes are added in each direction.

The schedule is long even by megaproject standards. The first of the three projects began construction in 2022; the southern section is expected to run to 2028, the northern to 2029 and the central section through 2033.
zh: 德卢斯的收尾段，其每英里造价高于这条路上几乎任何其他路段。1958 年的高架方案预计需十年、4,500 万美元；而后来仅迁移铁路调车场一项的估算，就同样是这个金额与这个工期。最终从梅萨巴大道到东 26 大道的延伸段耗资 2.2 亿美元，此后陆续获得三项联邦「优秀设计」奖。
如今的支出发生在这条路的另一端——奥斯汀，那里的高速公路 1962 年通车，双层高架 1975 年建成。得州交通部的「首府快线」计划覆盖约 28 英里，分三个项目，列明的施工费用合计约 56.5 亿美元。仅中段八英里就占约 45 亿美元：拆除双层高架，向两侧邻地拓宽，并在每个方向增设两条拼车车道。
即便以特大项目的标准衡量，工期也很长。三个项目中的第一个于 2022 年开工；南段预计延续至 2028 年，北段至 2029 年，中段则至 2033 年。

value.en: About $2.221 billion for the mainline, which FHWA logged in two pieces: $1.257 billion for Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri and Oklahoma, and $964.1 million for Texas, where I-35 and I-35E were accounted for together. The other lettered branches were logged separately — I-35W at Fort Worth $377.0 million, I-35E at Saint Paul $274.7 million, I-35W at Minneapolis $198.3 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 主线约 22.21 亿美元，联邦公路管理局将其分两笔登记：艾奥瓦、堪萨斯、明尼苏达、密苏里与俄克拉何马合计 12.57 亿美元；得克萨斯 9.641 亿美元，其中 I-35 与 I-35E 合并计账。其余带字母的分支单独登记——沃思堡 I-35W 为 3.770 亿、圣保罗 I-35E 为 2.747 亿、明尼阿波利斯 I-35W 为 1.983 亿美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

value.en: 1,494.50 miles — 407.23 in Texas, 301.45 in Minnesota, 235.45 in Kansas, 234.82 in Oklahoma, 205.58 in Iowa, 109.97 in Missouri. The lettered branches are logged separately: I-35E at 136.30 miles and I-35W at 127.23

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.en: Duluth extension, Mesaba Avenue to 26th Avenue East
label.zh: 德卢斯延伸段：梅萨巴大道至东 26 大道

value.en: $220 million as finished. An earlier project description put the 3.2-mile extension at $197 million, the largest single transportation project in north-eastern Minnesota; the 1958 elevated scheme it replaced had been costed at $45 million
value.zh: 竣工造价 2.2 亿美元。更早的项目说明将这段 3.2 英里的延伸列为 1.97 亿美元，是明尼苏达东北部最大的单项交通工程；它所取代的 1958 年高架方案当时估价 4,500 万美元

figures.source: Duluth News Tribune, May 2010; American Highway & Transportation, April 1989

value.en: About $5.65 billion in listed construction costs across three projects covering some 28 miles, of which the eight-mile central section is about $4.5 billion
value.zh: 三个项目合计列明施工费用约 56.5 亿美元，覆盖约 28 英里，其中八英里的中段约 45 亿美元

figures.source: Texas DOT figures, reported by CBS Austin, 2025, and the Austin Monitor, February 2024

label.zh: 莱夫·埃里克森隧道的弃方再利用

value.en: 179,000 tons of gabbro were excavated; about 1,400 truckloads were used to widen the beach along the Lakewalk, creating 6.3 acres of new public land
value.zh: 开挖辉长岩 179,000 吨；其中约 1,400 车用于加宽湖滨步道旁的沙滩，造出 6.3 英亩新的公共用地

value.en: In the 2024 Texas Top 100 list, based on 2023 conditions, the Austin segment from US 290 North to Ben White Boulevard ranked third statewide with 904,542 annual person-hours of delay and $197.2 million in congestion cost. I-35 in Austin held the overall top spot in the 2020 report and reclaimed first place for truck congestion in 2024
value.zh: 在依据 2023 年状况编制的 2024 年得州百大拥堵路段榜上，奥斯汀自 US 290 北至本怀特大道的路段全州排名第三，年延误 904,542 人·小时，拥堵成本 1.972 亿美元。I-35 奥斯汀段在 2020 年的报告中曾居总榜首位，并于 2024 年重夺卡车拥堵榜第一

trafficFigures.source: Texas DOT and Texas A&M Transportation Institute, 2024 Top 100 Congested Road Segments; TTI press release, December 2020

why.en: Six states count their own segments and the road's two lettered splits complicate any single total. Austin and the Twin Cities carry urban volumes an order of magnitude above rural Oklahoma and Iowa, and no agency averages them.
why.zh: 六个州各自统计本州路段，而这条路的两处字母分支使任何单一合计都变得复杂。奥斯汀与双子城的流量比俄克拉何马、艾奥瓦的乡村路段高出一个数量级，亦无机构对其取平均值。

value.en: Three FHWA Excellence in Highway Design awards, in 1992, 1994 and 1998, for the cut-and-cover tunnels, architectural treatments and landscaping
value.zh: 凭明挖回填隧道、建筑处理与景观设计，先后于 1992、1994 与 1998 年获得三项联邦公路管理局「优秀公路设计」奖

conditionFigures.source: FHWA, Highway History, By Day, 28 October; Duluth News Tribune, May 2010

value.en: The stacked upper lanes through central Austin opened in 1975 and are being demolished as part of the Capital Express Central project
value.zh: 穿过奥斯汀中心区的双层车道 1975 年通车，正在「首府快线中段」工程中拆除

timeline.en: Minnesota proposes carrying the freeway on pillars along the Duluth lakefront.
timeline.zh: 明尼苏达提出以立柱高架方式沿德卢斯湖滨修建高速公路。

timeline.en: Organised opposition in Duluth makes the elevated plan politically impossible.
timeline.zh: 德卢斯有组织的反对使高架方案在政治上不可行。

timeline.en: I-35 reaches Duluth, ending at Mesaba Avenue, where it stays for sixteen years.
timeline.zh: I-35 抵达德卢斯，止于梅萨巴大道，并在此停滞十六年。

timeline.en: Tunnel excavation begins in downtown Duluth.
timeline.zh: 德卢斯市中心的隧道开挖动工。

timeline.en: The extension opens to Lake Avenue in October.
timeline.zh: 延伸段于 10 月通至湖滨大道。

timeline.en: The Leif Erickson Tunnel opens on 28 October, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 莱夫·埃里克森隧道于 10 月 28 日通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: The first of the three Capital Express projects in Austin begins construction.
timeline.zh: 奥斯汀「首府快线」三个项目中的第一个开工。
